features.title: Asset 表 schema + migration（含 EmailTemplate 数据迁移 + RLS + ROLLBACK SQL + dual-write 兼容期）
features.acceptance: 新建 prisma migration <ts>_add_asset_table 含 Asset model + 3 enum (AssetType / AssetSource / AssetStatus) + 3 索引 + RLS policy asset_tenant_isolation（tenantId IS NULL 全 tenant 可见 OR tenantId = current_setting）；独立 migration <ts>_migrate_email_template_to_asset 把 EmailTemplate 行迁移到 Asset (type=email, source=system_seed/user_created/ai_generated based on metadata)；ROLLBACK SQL 文件保留；跑 migration 后 SELECT count(*) FROM asset WHERE type='email' = SELECT count(*) FROM email_template；system_seed 5 套（en+zh = 10 行）正确迁移 tenantId IS NULL；用户/AI 模板按 tenant_id 正确迁移；RLS test：tenant A 看不到 tenant B asset，能看到 system_seed；守门 test tests/integration/asset-rls.test.ts ≥ 4 case；EmailTemplate 表暂保留（dual-write 兼容期，独立 cleanup migration 1 周后做不在本批次）。详见 spec §F001 + ADR-011。

features.title: src/lib/assets/* 后端核心（CRUD + Zod content schema 集中 + RLS-aware queries）
features.acceptance: 新建 4 文件：schemas.ts (EmailContentSchema + VideoScriptContentSchema + ASSET_CONTENT_SCHEMAS 集中)、queries.ts (loadAssetsForListing/loadAssetDetail/loadAssetsForComposer/loadVariantTree/loadUsedIn 全走 withTenant RLS)、mutations.ts (createAsset/updateAsset/archiveAsset/deleteAsset 含 Zod content shape 校验)、types.ts (DTO)；createAsset/updateAsset 必须 Zod 校验 content type=email → EmailContentSchema 等；守门 test queries.test.ts + mutations.test.ts 各 ≥ 8 case；coverage ≥ 80% lines。详见 spec §F002。

features.title: AI generate / regenerate / variant tree（aigcgateway + audit log）
features.acceptance: src/lib/products/generateAiAssets.ts 抽到 src/lib/assets/generators/email-generator.ts + video-script-generator.ts + 共用 aigcgateway-client.ts（统一 timeout/retry/quota log）；新建 src/app/[locale]/(app)/assets/actions.ts:generateAssetAction({productId, type, steeringPrompt?, parentAssetId?})；首次 generate (parentAssetId 未传) 新建 root Asset parentId=null；regenerate (parentAssetId 传) 新建 child parentId=parentAssetId 名后缀 v(n+1)；audit log action 'asset.generated' / 'asset.regenerated' 含 traceId/model/tokensUsed/steeringPrompt；守门 test tests/integration/asset-generate-flow.test.ts ≥ 6 case (首次/regenerate/steering/locale/failure/audit log)；aigcgateway 余额合理 (~0.001-0.005 USD/generate)。详见 spec §F003。

features.acceptance: 三栏布局 ≥1280px 并列 [240/flex-1/440] / <1280px detail 改 modal；Filter URL state 5 param 双向同步深链+刷新+后退；AssetCard hover quick actions 4 按钮浮层；AssetCard selected cyan ring + bg 加深；AssetCard 含 type chip + AI 徽章 + variant index 'vN of M' + used count + status dot；Sort 4 选项 / View toggle Grid+List / '+ New Asset' 3-step wizard / Detail panel 4 tabs / '...' menu 6 项 (email/5 项 video) / Send to Outreach 仅 email / Empty state 双 CTA；Pagination cursor + IntersectionObserver PAGE_SIZE 24；与 design-draft/BL-025-asset-library/variant-a-296k/code.html 视觉一致性 PASS；§F004.A 公共组件清单 100% 覆盖（grep src/app/[locale]/(app)/assets/ 0 inline bg-[#/rounded-[d/手写 button 反范式）；§F004.B 19 不得简化全实装 + 4 不得新增全无；3 新组件抽到 src/components/common/ + 单元 test；如新建 Combobox 落 src/components/ui/Combobox.tsx + 守门 test；visual baseline 重生 4 个；守门 test tests/e2e/assets-page.spec.ts ≥ 8 case。详见 spec §F004。

features.title: Edit + Save + Versions tab + Used in tab
features.acceptance: Email Edit subject + body + 变量 chip 工具条（{{kol.name}} / {{product.name}} / {{campaign.name}} / {{kol.handle}} / {{today_date}} 5 hardcoded token）正确光标位置插入；Video Edit Markdown 编辑（@uiw/react-md-editor 或 textarea + preview tab）；Save 行为：updateAsset 覆盖 / 'Save as new version' createAsset 复制 + parentId；变更未保存离开弹 confirm；Versions tree mini Git-graph 风格递归回溯 root → leaves；Restore version (新 user_created variant) / Compare with current (diff modal)；Used in 聚合 email_log 引用计数；守门 test tests/integration/asset-edit-versions.test.ts ≥ 6 case。详见 spec §F005。
